in_marathi.name: Dandapaani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rod of punishment, discipline
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dandapaani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dandapaani is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Danda', which means a rod used for punishment, and 'paani', which means one who holds or bears. This name is given to a child who is believed to possess strong discipline and the ability to administer justice. In Hindu mythology, Lord Dharma, the God of righteousness and morality, holds a rod or danda, which represents the law and order in the universe.
